---
title: Strict fixture
description: Fixture for the strict sample compile.
---

A first block that compiles:

```ts
export const total: number = 1;
```

A block with an implicit any parameter:

```ts
const doubled = [1, 2].map((n) => n * 2);
export const names = ["a"].map((c) => c.length);
export function hello(user) {
  return user;
}
void doubled;
```

A block that uses a name nothing declares:

```ts
const result = queryOrders();
void result;
```

A block that compiles with the shared names:

```ts
const count: number = data.length + rows.length;
void count;
```
